# Email Signature Generator

> A browser-based email signature generator with 18 professional templates. One-time payment of $5 AUD for Pro. No subscription, no account required.

## What this tool does

Email Signature Generator (emailsignaturegenerator.ai) lets professionals create HTML email signatures in under 2 minutes. Users pick a template, enter their contact details, customise colours and fonts, and copy the finished signature into Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, or any other email client.

A companion **Email Signature Health Check** at /health-check audits any pasted signature HTML for contrast, Gmail dark-mode safety, Outlook compatibility, tracker pixels, accessibility, and size. It runs entirely in the browser and is free.

## Pricing

- **Free**: $0 — 6 templates with full customisation. Includes a small "Made with emailsignaturegenerator.ai" footer line.
- **Pro**: $5 AUD, one-time payment — All 18 templates, no branding, CTA buttons, industry templates, gradient designs, lifetime access.

No subscription. No recurring charges. No account needed.

## Key features

- Free **signature health check** — paste any signature HTML, get a full audit (contrast, Gmail dark-mode, Outlook, trackers, accessibility) in seconds
- Gmail dark-mode safe — every template renders correctly in both light and dark inboxes
- **Jurisdiction-aware compliance** — auto-fills your regulatory licence number (bar, NPI, AFSL, CRD, GMC, AHPRA, SRA, etc.) and appends the correct country-specific disclaimer (HIPAA, Circular 230, FCA, FINRA Reg BI, Legal Professional Privilege, etc.) for 7 regulated professions across US, UK, AU, and CA
- 18 signature templates across 6 categories: Professional, Creative, Minimal, Social-First, Sales/CTA, Industry
- Full colour customisation (primary, secondary, text colours via hex codes or colour picker)
- 8 email-safe fonts: Arial, Georgia, Verdana, Trebuchet, Tahoma, Courier, Times New Roman, Lucida
- Photo support: circle, rounded, or square shape; upload for preview or paste hosted URL for email
- Social icon links: website, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook — 4 icon styles (mono, colour, rounded, square)
- CTA buttons: customisable text and URL (e.g. "Book a Meeting")
- One-click copy: rich HTML for Gmail / plain text for any client
- Works in 50+ email clients: Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, Yahoo Mail, and more
- 30-day money-back guarantee
- No tracking, no data stored server-side

## Template categories

1. **Professional** — Clean corporate layouts with photo, contact info, and social links (2 free, 2 pro)
2. **Creative** — Bold colours, gradient accents, modern typography (1 free, 2 pro)
3. **Minimal** — Text-focused, ultra-lightweight, no images (2 free, 1 pro)
4. **Social-First** — Large social icons, ideal for creators and influencers (1 free, 1 pro)
5. **Sales / CTA** — Built-in call-to-action buttons for meetings and demos (1 free, 2 pro)
6. **Industry** — Purpose-built for real estate, trades, consulting (1 free, 2 pro)

## Frequently asked questions

**Is this a one-time payment?**
Yes. Pay $5 AUD once and get lifetime access to all Pro templates, including future templates. No subscription, no recurring charges.

**Does it work in Gmail and Outlook?**
Yes. All signatures use HTML table-based layouts compatible with Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, Yahoo Mail, and 50+ other email clients.

**Do I need an account?**
No. The generator runs entirely in your browser. No login, no account, no tracking. Pro access is stored in your browser.

**Can I update my signature later?**
Yes. Come back anytime and create a new signature. Pro access persists in your browser with no limits.

**Is there a refund policy?**
Yes. 30-day money-back guarantee. Email info@strata-reports.ai.

## Competitor comparison

Unlike subscription-based tools (typically $9/month = $108/year), Email Signature Generator charges a single $5 one-time fee. It is positioned as a lightweight, privacy-respecting alternative to enterprise tools like Exclaimer, WiseStamp, or MySignature.
